# Copilot Instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for project-wide rules. Before working in a specialized area, read the matching skill's `SKILL.md` for its workflow and constraints. Treat the skill as additional domain guidance; it does not override `AGENTS.md`.

## Skill Routing

- Expo Router navigation, route structure, links, and native navigation: [expo-router](../.agents/skills/expo-router/SKILL.md)
- Native controls, sheets, pickers, and platform UI using `@expo/ui`: [expo-ui](../.agents/skills/expo-ui/SKILL.md)
- Expo animations, gestures, transitions, and haptics: [expo-animation](../.agents/skills/expo-animation/SKILL.md)
- Theme tokens, reusable components, or design-system consistency: [expo-design-system](../.agents/skills/expo-design-system/SKILL.md)
- Expo native modules, config plugins, or native views: [expo-module](../.agents/skills/expo-module/SKILL.md)
- Folder structure for a new Expo app: [expo-project-structure](../.agents/skills/expo-project-structure/SKILL.md)
- Expo SDK upgrades or dependency compatibility: [expo-upgrade](../.agents/skills/expo-upgrade/SKILL.md)
- EAS workflow YAML and Expo CI/CD pipelines: [eas-workflows](../.agents/skills/eas-workflows/SKILL.md)
- React Native performance, profiling, lists, or responsiveness: [react-native-best-practices](../.agents/skills/react-native-best-practices/SKILL.md)
- React Native Testing Library component tests: [react-native-testing](../.agents/skills/react-native-testing/SKILL.md)
- Compressed communication style: [caveman](../.agents/skills/caveman/SKILL.md), only when the user requests it.

Read the skill file before applying its specialized guidance; do not assume a skill has been loaded just because a task matches its description. For Expo, EAS, or React Native API changes, also follow the version-specific documentation requirements in `AGENTS.md`.
